from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
from pyscf import gto, dft
sm='C1C2C3N=COCC3N12'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(sm))
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=12
ok=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)
print('embed:',ok)
print('MMFF optimization:',AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m))
conf=m.GetConformer()
atoms=[(a.GetSymbol(),tuple(conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()))) for a in m.GetAtoms()]
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms,basis='def2-svp',charge=0,spin=0,verbose=0)
calc=dft.RKS(mol); calc.xc='b3lyp'; calc.conv_tol=1e-9
calc.kernel()
e=np.sort(calc.mo_energy); n=mol.nelectron//2
h,l=e[n-1],e[n]
print('B3LYP/def2-SVP HOMO Ha:',float(h))
print('B3LYP/def2-SVP LUMO Ha:',float(l))
print('Gap Ha:',float(l-h))
